messages: maria: Heads-up — mkdocs build failing on staging for the i18n site. linkcheck shows an unresolved fragment for a heading that contains an emoji. CI log: https://ci.internal/job/402 (see linkcheck output). Anyone on docs CI? dev-bot: CI: build_402 failed — linkcheck error: 'Unresolved fragment: #🚀-quickstart' (docs/en/getting-started.md). Full job: https://ci.internal/job/402 alex: I ran it locally. MkDocs slugify on my machine (mac/linux) strips emoji differently than the CI worker. Docusaurus build (for the hosted site) still resolves that anchor — looks like differing slugify implementations between our two toolchains. jon: Can you paste the exact heading so we can reproduce deterministic slug? Maybe we should just add an explicit id in the source. maria: Sure — offending heading: ## Quickstart 🚀 — Redwood in 5 mins file: docs/en/getting-started.md zia: Quick short-term fix: add an explicit HTML anchor before the heading: ` ## Quickstart 🚀 — Redwood in 5 mins`. MkDocs-material will respect that. Alternatively move emoji out of the header text. alex: We could also standardize slugify config with python-markdown extension or a small preprocessor, but that's a longer lift. For Docusaurus you can do explicit header id like `## Quickstart 🚀 {#quickstart}` in MDX, but that's not portable across mkdocs. jon: Short term I'd prefer removing/moving the emoji to avoid blocking the release. Long term: unify slugify behavior (DOCS-239?). maria: OK — I'll open a tiny PR: 1) remove emoji from the header (put it in the intro paragraph), 2) fix a separate code sample that is currently breaking mkdocs fenced block parsing in /examples/sdk.md. dev-bot: Jira: DOCS-239 created for unify-slugify across builds. Ticket: https://jira.internal/browse/DOCS-239 alex: For the code fence bug, FYI mkdocs' markdown parser is picky about a blank line before a fenced block when preceded by a list or indented paragraph. Example fix: add an empty line before the block. zia: Example snippet to include in the PR (fixes fenced code parsing): (ensure a blank line above) ```js // examples/sdk.md const client = require('@redwood/sdk').createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY }) console.log(await client.generate('hello')) ``` maria: I'll do two commits in one PR: short heading change + code fence fixes. I'll reference DOCS-239 and the CI failure in the PR description. ETA ~2 hours, will ping here when ready. jon: Please add a CHANGES entry since this touches i18n files; localization should be notified. alex: Also I'll add a temporary linkcheck config to ignore emoji-fragments while we roll out slugify unification (should be a one-week window). maria: Will mention @localization and file a small request for translators after merge. tagging this thread resolved once CI passes. dev-bot: CI: build_405 queued (waiting for PR build).
